title: Peakspan: Defining, Quantifying and Extending the Boundaries of Peak Productive Lifespan

fields.title: Peakspan: Defining, Quantifying and Extending the Boundaries of Peak Productive Lifespan
fields.authors: Zhavoronkov, A., Ying, K., & Wilczok, D.
fields.description: The article defines Peakspan as the age interval during which a person retains at least 90% of peak performance in a physiological or cognitive domain. It argues that tracking functional decline beyond disease-free survival could guide efforts to preserve capacity across the life course.

descriptions.text: The article defines Peakspan as the age interval during which a person retains at least 90% of peak performance in a physiological or cognitive domain. pdfFigures.legendSourceText: Figure 1. Cumulative graph of Peakspan across systems. Comprehensive written analysis of peak and rate of decline of each selected system has been performed. For the graphic purposes, cardiorespiratory system decline was proxied by VO2 max. The endocrine system was proxied by IGF1. Female reproductive capacity was proxied by the ability to conceive. Male reproductive system was proxied by total progressive motile sperm count. The renal system was proxied by eGFR. The sensory system was proxied by olfactory system performance. The digestive system was proxied by hepatic unbound clearance. Fluid and crystallized intelligence were proxied by WAIS scores. The musculoskeletal system was proxied by ankle dorsiflexion force-control. All proxies are based on limited but high-quality studies and are presented for illustrative purposes rather than as precise quantitative estimates.
